summary.text: MediShield Life helps with large hospital bills and costly outpatient treatments. CareShield Life provides cash payouts for long-term care.

details.heading: MediShield Life purpose
details.body: MediShield Life helps to pay for large hospital bills and selected costly outpatient treatments such as dialysis and chemotherapy for cancer.

details.heading: CareShield Life purpose
details.body: CareShield Life provides cash payouts to help severely disabled individuals with their long-term care costs.
